verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local and cloud model runtime with a REST API, SDKs, and agent launch integrations, so a scheduling capability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows no first-party way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, nor any cron-like trigger or one-off-versus-recurring scheduling. Integrations such as OpenClaw and the SDKs are adjacent building blocks or user-side workarounds, not a documented scheduling feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
